text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — after yesterday's kernel-chooser tweak I'm seeing a regression on /generate-route for long-context jobs (~8k). p50 token latency up ~12–18ms and p95 up more. Anyone already triaged?

mohit: I just pulled per-route KPIs — KV hit rate on that route dropped from ~92% -> 76% around the deploy window. That would inflate per-token work.

perf-bot: alert: route=/generate token_latency_p50 +13ms, token_latency_p95 +42ms, kv_hit_rate -16pct (detected at 2024-11-07T11:04Z).

sam: I glanced at runtime logs — we have a lot of `kernel_hint=batch=large` churn even for single-req slices. Could be heuristic misfiring and forcing a different kernel path (larger planning overhead).

devon: Can someone post a timeline snippet? If we can correlate request_id -> kernel log lines / trace we can pin where the extra time goes. I can add a dashboard link once we have trace ids.

elaine: Proposal: add lightweight per-request "slice" events so the frontend dashboard can annotate a per-token waterfall. Events to emit (minimal fields): KV_HIT / KV_MISS, KERNEL_SWITCH (old->new, kernel_name), BATCH_BOUNDARY (batch_size), and per-token timestamps tok_start / tok_end. Each event must include `request_id` and `x-rw-trace` (if present) so the UI can link to APM traces. Example emit: `emit_event("KERNEL_SWITCH", {request_id, kernel_name, batch_size})`.

mohit: That seems cheap. We can reuse tracing client and the existing `x-rw-trace` header. Need to ensure sample rules won't drop these events — maybe mark as low-overhead metrics but always attach to active sampled traces in staging. Also add route-level metrics: `token_latency_by_route`, `kv_hit_rate_by_route`, and `kernel_switch_count_by_route`.

sam: I'll implement kernel log correlation first: attach `request_id` to kernel log lines and emit the KERNEL_SWITCH event when chooser flips path. I'll open a branch `runtime/token-events` and aim for a PR today.

devon: On the visualization side I'll add a new "Request Slices" panel to Grafana/console that draws horizontal bars per request with color-coded KV hit/miss, kernel segments, batch size overlays, and a link-out to the APM trace (if present). That requires the events endpoint and a small frontend change to resolve trace id -> APM link.

perf-bot: plan: run a synthetic replay with `seed=chat-8k-long-context` and baseline from last known good (before kernel-chooser change). Comparator job will compute p50/p95 diffs and kv_hit_rate deltas and post a diff.

elaine: Action items: sam – PR with kernel log + event emit (EOD). mohit – enable event emission in staging and ensure sampling flag. devon – dashboard panel prototype and link behavior. I'll run replay compare once staging emits are present and report numbers here. @sam @mohit @devon :thumbsup:

sam: Quick follow-up — I also noticed KV warmup counters got moved by the batching rewrite; I'll add `kv_warmup_miss` counter (annotated by request_id) so we can see if warmup is being delayed by larger batch assembly.

mohit: FYI I toggled `prefer_small_batch` in staging as an experiment; immediate result was ~30ms p95 reduction on that route. Keeping the experiment while we roll the instrumentation+fix.

elaine: Great. Let's keep chatter here for results and link any perf diffs/links. If we can get per-token waterfall + trace link we'll be set to root-cause and roll a targeted fix.
